data.title: Sombr Essentials
data.description: There’s a subtle magnetism to Sombr’s music. Sparse, reflective, and deeply felt, his catalog leans into vulnerability without losing its edge. These essentials spotlight the moments that define his sonic world, Understated hooks, layered production, and a storytelling style that lingers long after the last note. (Photo: Warner/Press)

data.title: Lil Uzi Vert Essentials
data.description: Philadelphia rapper, Lil Uzi Vert has been securing bags and co-signs since their breakthrough hit, "XO TOUR Llif3." Enter the world of Uzi. (Photo: Roc Nation)

data.title: Brent Faiyaz Essentials
data.description: Check out the best from the Maryland singer and producer Brent Faiyaz. (Photo: UnitedMaster, Press)

data.title: Thundercat Essentials
data.description: Armed with sweet falsetto vocals and too-good-to-be-true bass playing, Thundercat makes quirky funk music unlike anything you've ever heard. In this playlist, you'll hear tracks from Thundercat albums like Drunk, It Is What It Is, and his 2013 masterpiece, Apocalypse. (Photo: Rovi)

data.title: Soul Classics
data.description: Celebrating Earth, Wind & Fire and their brand-new, Questlove-directed documentary. Rediscover these timeless and unforgettable soul songs on a nostalgic journey. (Cover: Earth, Wind & Fire // Photo: Sandy Speiser; SME)

data.title: Viral Classics
data.description: Hit songs, some of which spent months dominating the charts, have a way of enjoying a second life years after their release - appearing on a movie soundtrack, selling cars in a TV commercial, or providing TikTokkers with the perfect music accompaniment for their cat videos. You hear them again and are immediately transported back to the first time you heard them. And the time after that. And... (Cover: Yuna / Photo:  press)

data.title: New Midwest: Hip-Hop
data.description: You know what the Midwest is? Young and restless. Show love to the new and OG generation of Midwest rhyme-slingers. (Cover: Rio Da Yung Og // Photo: EMPIRE, Press)

data.title: Drill Hype: Rap
data.description: Drill Music, a Hip-Hop subgenre, emerged in Chicago and has since spread nationwide and internationally. The high-energy, edgy sound is a fresh twist on Gangsta Rap that isn’t slowing down any time soon. (Cover: Tsu Surf // Photo: foundationmedia, Press)
